ops-bot: ALERT: notify-service high 5xx rate detected in eu-west-1. Routing to oncall-sre. incident_id=inc_2145309999 :rotating_light:
Maya Chen: seeing a flurry of duplicate pages — got 3 separate PD pages for the same incident id within 30s. anyone else?
Sanjay Patel: yup, saw dupes. looks like pages from eu-west-1 and eu-central repeated. PD shows different pager_ids but same payload body.
Maya Chen: hmm. any recent deploys to alert-orchestrator or the webhook-proxy?
Liz Hart: I pushed a small change to the orchestrator earlier that adds region hints to headers (PR #482). rolled out 08:42 UTC.
Devin Rios: checking webhook-proxy logs now. grabbing lines where incident_id=inc_2145309999
Devin Rios: ```
2024-11-09T08:54:10Z INFO deliver: incident=inc_2145309999 target=pagerduty payload_id=abc123 headers={"x-region":"eu-west-1"}
2024-11-09T08:54:10Z ERROR deliver: duplicate-detect: missing-delta-route header, generated new pager_id=PD-8991
2024-11-09T08:54:10Z INFO deliver: incident=inc_2145309999 target=pagerduty payload_id=abc123 headers={"x-region":"eu-central-1"}
2024-11-09T08:54:11Z ERROR deliver: duplicate-detect: missing-delta-route header, generated new pager_id=PD-8992
```
Sanjay Patel: looks like the router change added x-region but the downstream duplicate-suppression expects x-delta-route (new header name). when missing, it treats each incoming as distinct and issues new pagerduty calls.
Maya Chen: so the change broke deduping. this explains multiple PD pages. PD shows multiple ACKs coming back later which matched only one; oncall got confused.
oncall-sre: receiving multiple pages caused stale acknowledgment race. I'm currently muted on PD but still seeing the slack thread flood.
Liz Hart: sorry — my PR renamed the header for clarity. I can roll back in 5m if that helps.
Devin Rios: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily disable webhook-proxy outbound to PD for eu-central-1 (prevent new duplicates), 2) toggle orchestrator flag to send x-delta-route again, 3) dedupe cleanup job to reconcile pager_ids.
Maya Chen: do step 1 now? we need to stop more duplicates while we fix headers.
Devin Rios: disabling eu-central-1 -> PD outbound (done) 08:58 UTC :white_check_mark:
Sanjay Patel: I'm opening PD incident and annotating duplicates to avoid multiple oncall escalations. also adding note to suppress automated re-notify in PD for 10m.
Liz Hart: rolling back header rename in orchestrator. PR to revert is live, rolling to 3% canary -> 50% -> 100%. will post progress.
Maya Chen: customer impact: internal metric shows ~2% of requests failing with 5xx, majority from a single tenant cluster in eu-west-1. however paging noise amplified ops overhead. external customers: one paid customer reported delayed support response due to us triaging multiple pages; ops contacted them 09:12 UTC.
Devin Rios: can we mark this P1->P2? impact limited to elevated errors + paging noise. ops cost high but user-visible outage was short. recommend P2 with immediate followups.
Maya Chen: agreed. assign postmortem to "alert-routing-dedupe-header-mismatch" and include rollout checklist change (require header compatibility tests + PD dedupe simulation).
oncall-sre: acknowledged. I'll keep monitoring PD and we can unmute eu-central outbound once headers line up.
Liz Hart: rollback completed 09:03 UTC. canary healthy.
Devin Rios: re-enabled eu-central-1 -> PD outbound 09:06 UTC. watching for duplicates.
Sanjay Patel: PD shows no new duplicate incidents after 09:07 UTC. removing temporary suppress in 5m.
Maya Chen: thanks everyone. next steps: postmortem doc (assign), follow-up test to simulate header-mismatch in staging, add automated dedupe integration test.
ops-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: inc_2145309999 status=resolved resolved_by=Maya Chen resolved_at=2145310800
Maya Chen: I'll start the postmortem note and ping for reviewers later today. :memo:
